description: 登记实际原图身份错误修正及两新完整原期、同钟多维背景，43/79部分支持保持全源未过，无金融
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib,re
import pandas as pd
base=Path('reports/research/510300_industrial_full_government_original_carrier_probe_v1')
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def read(p):return json.loads(Path(p).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def save(name,x):
 p=base/name;assert not p.exists()
 p.write_text(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False),encoding='utf-8')
receipt=read(base/'首四不同原载体实际取得及所有原表链接.json')
reports={r['period']:r for r in receipt['reports']}
manual=read(base/'原图目视身份及2018财务经济总计.json')
for i in manual['original_paths_and_hashes']:assert hashlib.sha256(Path(i['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==i['sha256']
source2018={**manual['current_2018_original_financial_totals'],**manual['current_2018_original_economic_totals'],'应收期末_亿元':146000.0,'应收原可比同比_百分数':10.9,'产成品库存期末_亿元':43762.2,'产成品库存原可比同比_百分数':9.5,'应收回收期同比变化_天':0.4,'库存周转同比变化_天':0.0}
nbs=reports['2020M12_NBS'];assert nbs['status']=='ORIGINAL_FULL_TEXT_CANDIDATE'
totals=[next((r for r in t['rows'] if r and r[0]=='总计'),None) for t in nbs['all_original_tables']]
financial=next(t for t in totals if t and len(t)==7)
economic=next(t for t in totals if t and len(t)==9)
source2020=dict(zip(['营业收入累计_亿元','营业收入原可比同比_百分数','营业成本累计_亿元','营业成本原可比同比_百分数','利润累计_亿元','利润原可比同比_百分数'],map(float,financial[1:])))
source2020.update(dict(zip(['原收入利润率_百分数','原每百元收入成本_元','原每百元收入费用_元','原每百元资产收入_元','原人均收入_万元','资产负债率_百分数','产成品库存周转_天','应收平均回收期_天'],map(float,economic[1:]))))
source2020.update({'应收期末_亿元':164100.0,'应收原可比同比_百分数':15.1,'产成品库存期末_亿元':46000.0,'产成品库存原可比同比_百分数':7.5,'应收回收期同比变化_天':5.8,'库存周转同比变化_天':1.2})
rows=[
 {'economic_period':'2018M10','actual_carrier_type':'CURRENT_COMPLETE_SAME_PERIOD_GOVERNMENT_REPORT_WITH_VISUALLY_READ_FULL_TABLES','receipt_key':'2018M10','url':reports['2018M10']['url'],'sha256':reports['2018M10']['sha256'],'publication_display':'2018-11-27','available_at':'2018-11-27T23:59:59+08:00','clock_method':'ORIGINAL_GOVERNMENT_PUBLICATION_DAY_END_CONSERVATIVE','income_scope':'主营业务收入','receivable_scope':'应收账款','inventory_cost_scope':'主营业务成本','current_quantities':source2018,'full_current_source_qualified':True,'notes_original':'原正文/附注及全表长图均在同一政府当期原页；保留营业及主营双原量，无跨期桥'},
 {'economic_period':'2020M12','actual_carrier_type':'CURRENT_PRIMARY_NBS_FULL_REPORT_WITH_VISIBLE_0930_PUBLICATION_CLOCK','receipt_key':'2020M12_NBS','url':nbs['url'],'sha256':nbs['sha256'],'publication_display':'2021/01/27 09:30','available_at':'2021-01-27T09:30:00+08:00','clock_method':'ORIGINAL_NBS_VISIBLE_PUBLICATION_CLOCK','income_scope':'营业收入','receivable_scope':'应收账款','inventory_cost_scope':'营业成本','current_quantities':source2020,'full_current_source_qualified':True,'notes_original':'原国家统计局全文/原表和日期直接成立；政府2020正文/方法可核，但其余原表图未读，不把该政府载体宣称已完整核原表'}
]
save('新增两期原共同数量提取与同钟登记.json',{'at':now(),'rows_before_background_alignment':rows,'financial_and_stock_labels':'NOT_READ_NOT_REGISTERED_NOT_RUN','image_identity_initial_error_preserved':True,'unknown_other_prototypes':['2019M12原表未读','2021M02有限四查询没有全国原完整载体'],'no_horizon_or_members_change':True})
old=Path('reports/research/510300_enterprise_working_capital_source_v1')
joint=Path('reports/research/510300_enterprise_multidimensional_original_state_discovery_v1')
features=['订单水平','订单月度变化','资金利率与政策利率差','融资五日净变化','融资买入活跃度','指数趋势强度','短长波动比','成交活跃度']
survey=['宏观经济热度指数','产品销售价格感受指数','原材料购进价格感受指数','国内订单指数','出口订单指数','资金周转指数','销货款回笼指数','经营景气指数','盈利指数']
df=pd.read_parquet(old/'原八字段与企业周转_未读股票标签_v1_0_1.parquet',columns=['idx','date','decision_time']+features)
df['clock']=pd.to_datetime(df.decision_time,utc=True)
pbc=read(old/'全部29当前资金周转值与方法_同原标点修正_v1_0_1.json')['targets']
states={r['quarter']:r for r in read(joint/'全部29原共同状态九维及字段原段.json')['rows']}
for r in rows:
 src=reports[r['receipt_key']]
 assert hashlib.sha256(Path(src['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==r['sha256']
 assert r['publication_display'] in src['full_text']
 clock=pd.Timestamp(r['available_at']).tz_convert('UTC')
 d=df[df.clock>clock].sort_values('clock').iloc[0]
 known=[x for x in pbc if pd.Timestamp(x['original_publication_display'])<=d.clock]
 p=max(known,key=lambda x:x['quarter']) if known else None
 r['first_original_decision_clock_after_source']=str(d.decision_time)
 r['old_eight_known_background']={f:float(d[f]) if pd.notna(d[f]) else 'UNKNOWN' for f in features}
 r['survey_economic_quarter_known_asof_clock']=p['quarter'] if p else 'UNKNOWN'
 r['survey_information_age_days']=float((d.clock-pd.Timestamp(p['original_publication_display']).tz_convert('UTC')).total_seconds()/86400) if p else 'UNKNOWN'
 r['survey_original_fields_asof_clock']={f:states[p['quarter']][f] for f in survey} if p and p['source_gate_qualified'] else {f:'UNKNOWN' for f in survey}
 r.update(historical_first_vintage_authenticated=False,actual_cash_received_or_financing_flow='UNKNOWN',specific_economic_cause_identified=False,CSI300_exposure='UNKNOWN',market_consensus_expectation='UNKNOWN',future_stock_response='NOT_READ_NOT_COMPUTED')
save('新增两原期_同钟多维数量与既有背景_不加权.json',{'at':now(),'rows':rows,'source_discovery_not_financial_comparison':True,'new_stock_labels':0,'new_model_fits':0})
original=read('reports/research/510300_industrial_cash_constraint_original_panel_v1/全部79原期_共同数量九维及原表方法_未知保留_v1_0_1.json')
qualified={r['economic_period'] for r in original['rows'] if r['current_original_joint_source_qualified']}
assert len(qualified)==41
qualified.update(r['economic_period'] for r in rows)
allperiods=[r['economic_period'] for r in original['rows']]
missing=[p for p in allperiods if p not in qualified]
assert len(qualified)==43 and len(missing)==36
save('原79来源新增载体接续_金融未运行.json',{'at':now(),'original_result_preserved':'reports/research/510300_industrial_cash_constraint_original_panel_v1/result_v1_0_1.json','original_79':allperiods,'source_qualified_periods':sorted(qualified),'new_qualified_periods':['2018M10','2020M12'],'remaining_unknown_36':missing,'original1711_and1212_unchanged':True,'complete_same_pool_source_support':'NOT_COMPUTED_DURING_PARTIAL_GATE','full_79_gate_passed':False,'new_labels_or_models':0})
result={'study_id':read(base/'protocol.json')['study_id'],'experiment_id':'E91','completed_at':now(),'status':'DISTINCT_EARLY_GOVERNMENT_FULL_CARRIER_AND_PRIMARY_ORIGINAL_FOUND_PARTIAL43_OF79_FULL_GATE_NOT_PASSED','official_queries_actual':4,'primary_web_opens_actual':4,'web_NBS_internal_error_preserved_first_raw_GET_success':True,'distinct_raw_original_GETs_actual':8,'actual_HTML_reports':4,'actual_source_images':4,'all_raw_GETs_successful':True,'prototype_periods':4,'different_complete_government_prototypes_qualified':1,'current_primary_NBS_full_publication_clock_prototypes_qualified':1,'qualified_new_periods':['2018M10','2020M12'],'gov_2019_original_text_but_financial_and_effect_tables_not_read':True,'gov_2020_remaining_original_table_images_not_read':True,'national_2021M02_original_not_located_in_registered_queries':True,'image_selection_identity_initial_error_preserved':True,'old_financial_rejections_and_source_limits_preserved':True,'original79_current_sources_now_qualified':43,'remaining_unknown_original_periods':36,'full_source_gate_passed':False,'current_source_clock_vs_receipt_vs_first_vintage_separate':True,'first_2020_actual_scope_switch_month_and_common_bridge':'UNKNOWN_NOT_AUTHENTICATED','new_model_fits':0,'new_linear_regressions':0,'new_simple_weighted_scores':0,'new_stock_labels':0,'new_accounts':0,'source_code_edits':0,'raw_GET_retries':0,'authentication':0,'financial_status':'NOT_REGISTERED_NOT_RUN','goal_achieved':False,'net_sharpe':'NOT_COMPUTED','current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False,'independent_validation':False}
save('result.json',result)
p=base/'不同早期原载体_多维数量与接续结果.md';assert not p.exists()
p.write_text('# E91：不同早期原载体的实际结果\n\n有限四原官方查询、四网页原页读取及八首次原GET实际结束。2018年10月政府原页有完整当期原全文、统计定义和全财务/经济表长图，目视全表总计核过；原公开日2018-11-27按日末保守。2020年全年另由实际查询找到NBS原全文/原表/2021-01-27 09:30显示钟。\n\n初次前两图定位误称为财务经济表：2018第一图和2019前两图实际为历史图，2018第二图才为完整表长图。原图身份及初次错误/修正留存；2019正文可读但其财务/经济表图未取得，不能称该原载体完整通过；2020政府其余原表未读，合格的是直接NBS原页。2021年2月查询出现地区总体，不能替全国原目标。\n\n2018本期主营同比9.3%/成本9.0%/利润13.6%/应收10.9%/回收延长0.4天；2020收入0.8%/成本0.6%/利润4.1%/应收15.1%/回收延长5.8天。盈利扩张和现金占款压力可共存；与同一可知钟的内外订单、售价/原料、资金价格/融资、趋势波动并列，不加权、不线性或因果/股市收益证明。2020原附注说报表格式改变后从2020年恢复应收单列，但真正首次发布口径/版本桥仍未知，不回拼2019含票据绝对序列。\n\n新增两不同完整原期后固定79当前源43齐/36未知，原1711/1212不变，全源门未过，金融未登记未运行。真正首版与独立验证仍未证，净夏普NOT_COMPUTED、目标未达。\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),flush=True)
